issue.title: Upgrade Fluent Mobile to Expo SDK 58
issue.body:
## Goal

Upgrade Fluent Mobile from Expo SDK 57 to Expo SDK 58 as a dedicated, validated dependency migration.

## Scope

- Follow the official Expo SDK 58 upgrade guidance
- Upgrade Expo and the compatible React Native dependency set together
- Include the compatible `react-native-worklets` update
- Evaluate the deferred TypeScript 7 and Prettier 3 upgrades separately; include them only if supported and low-risk
- Regenerate native projects or configuration only where required
- Review app configuration, plugins, EAS profiles, and native modules for compatibility
- Preserve current app behavior and release workflows

## Validation

- Clean dependency install
- `expo-doctor`
- Expo dependency compatibility check
- Formatting and lint checks
- TypeScript checks
- Unit tests
- Architecture guards
- iOS and Android development builds
- Smoke test authentication, navigation, audio, downloads, and other native-module flows

## Context

Dependabot updates for the Expo group and React Native Worklets were closed because they fail current SDK 57 compatibility checks. The grouped development-tool update was also closed because its major upgrades need separate validation.

comments.body:
## Hold: wait for stable Expo SDK 58

**Not Dev Ready** until Expo publishes a stable `expo@58` release with release notes.

### Why
- As of 2026-09-14, `expo@latest` is still **57.0.22**.
- `expo@next` is **58.0.0-preview.1** only (no https://expo.dev/changelog/sdk-58 yet).
- Preview `bundledNativeModules` pins **React Native `0.88.0-rc.0`** plus `react-native-worklets@0.12.2` / `reanimated@4.6.0` — too early for a production Android upgrade PR.
- Closed Dependabot [#523](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/523) (expo group → 58) and [#521](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/521) (worklets) correctly failed on current SDK 57 compatibility checks.

### When to pick up
Re-open for implementation when:
1. Stable `expo@^58.0.0` is on npm `latest` (or an official beta with a changelog),
2. SDK 58 release notes / upgrade section exist,
3. RN target is a stable line (not RC).

Android-only validation only (no iOS) — see repo android-only policy.

`/start-issue #536` deferred by explicit decision.

## Dependabot batch notes (2026-09-29)

**Merged (1)**
- #557 — `@tanstack/react-query` 5.102.8 → 5.104.0 (safe, CI-first; all required checks green). Squash-merged → `99de1a9`.

**Closed without merge (3)** — peer/SDK conflicts; no `--force` / `--legacy-peer-deps`
- #555 — `react-native-worklets` 0.10.1 → 0.13.0; conflicts with `reanimated@4.5.1` peer `worklets@0.10.x` → #536
- #556 — dev-tools group includes TypeScript 7 + Prettier 3; typescript-eslint peers TS `<6.1.0` → #536 (evaluate separately)
- #608 — Expo group pulls `expo-router`/`expo-updates`/`expo-navigation-bar` to v58 on SDK 57 → #536

**Queue empty** after this pass. Resolution-log catch-up deferred to a ticketed chore PR (never commit on `main`).
